spans.s:
n. (-धं)
The fruit of the Indian fig, &c.
E.
न्यग्रोध the fig tree, &c. and अण् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Made of the skin, &c. of the deer, called न्यङ्क.
E.
न्यङ्कु, and अण् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Self-government or subjugation.
E.
नियत, and ष्पञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
According to rule, regular, enjoined.
E.
नियम, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A logician, a follower of the Nyāya or logical philosophy.
E.
न्याय the Nyāya system, and ठक् aff.
